items.text: The ROMA Lab Manual (2026 Edition) is now online. The handbook is published as a versioned, locally hosted archive — with embedded videos and figures — alongside earlier editions and the continuously updated Notion draft. Read the 2026 edition →

CIT @ ROMA Lab has been upgraded from v4.3 to v5.3. The new edition introduces a six-dimension research-temperament profile (boundary, communication, empathy, integrity, creativity, resilience), a fixed 50-item bank, a separate lab-preference layer and a single scoring engine. Explore the CIT →

ROMA Lab welcomes Sixu An (Ph.D., 2026 Spring), Yufan Wen (Master, 2026 Fall) and undergraduate researchers Shurong Liu, Xi Yao, Zihan Zhang and Zihan Yuan. Their research spans graph prompt learning, LLM social cognition and pragmatics, research evaluation, and LLM4Graph benchmarking.

Three students will join ROMA Lab as master students in September 2027: Hao Wu (Southeast University), Xinyu Zhong (Central South University) and Rouxi Shen (Southeast University). Their research interests span LLM agents, secure code generation and agent planning. Welcome aboard!

ROMA Lab papers accepted at EMNLP 2026 (main conference), KDD 2026 and CIKM 2026, spanning LLM robustness, long-term spatio-temporal forecasting and circuit-aware unlearning for LLM-based recommendation.

Dr. Xiangguo SUN takes on new senior service roles: Area Chair for KDD 2026 (Research Track, Cycle 2) and WWW 2027, and editorial roles at Information Processing & Management, Big Data Mining and Analytics, Journal of Social Computing and the International Journal on Social Computing and Social Intelligence.
Dr. Xiangguo SUN will serve as SPC for IJCAI 2026 and SIGIR 2026.
Dr. Xiangguo SUN has joined Southeast University as a Full Professor.
CIT @ ROMA Lab (ROMA Lab Cultural Insight Test) version 4.3 released.
Dr. Xiangguo SUN was awarded NeurIPS'2025 Top Reviewer.
Dr. Xiangguo Sun has been appointed to a dual leadership role at CAAI: Deputy Secretary-General for Social Computing and Social Intelligence, and Chair of the new Rising Scholars Committee.
